# SendPulse

> SendPulse is a multi-channel marketing automation platform combining email, SMS, web push, and chatbots in a single unified interface.

SendPulse serves a global audience with localized versions in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Latin America), Turkish, Italian, German, Indonesian, and Russian. The platform provides free and paid plans with features ranging from bulk email and SMS campaigns to advanced workflow automation and customer engagement tools.

## Key Topics

- Email Marketing
- SMS Campaigns
- Marketing Automation
- Chatbots
- Web Push Notifications
- Automation 360
- Multi-Channel Platform
- WhatsApp
- Facebook Messenger
- Instagram

## Core Platform

- [SendPulse - Multi-Channel Marketing Automation Platform](https://sendpulse.com/en): SendPulse multi-channel platform: email, SMS, web push, chatbots

## Email Marketing & Automation

- [Bulk Email Service](https://sendpulse.com/features/email): SendPulse bulk email service with drag-and-drop builder
- [Email Automation - Automation 360](https://sendpulse.com/features/automation-360): Automation 360: email workflow automation for customer lifecycle
- [Transactional Emails](https://sendpulse.com/features/transactional): SendPulse transactional email service with SMTP integration

## SMS & Web Push Notifications

- [Bulk SMS Service](https://sendpulse.com/features/sms): SendPulse bulk SMS service across 800 networks globally
- [Web Push Notifications](https://sendpulse.com/features/webpush): SendPulse web push notifications for browser-based campaigns

## Chatbots & Messaging

- [WhatsApp Chatbot](https://sendpulse.com/features/chatbot/whatsapp): SendPulse WhatsApp chatbot with no-code drag-and-drop builder
- [Facebook Messenger Chatbot](https://sendpulse.com/features/chatbot/facebook): SendPulse Facebook Messenger chatbot with no-code builder
- [Instagram Chatbot](https://sendpulse.com/features/chatbot/instagram): SendPulse Instagram chatbot for direct messaging automation
- [Live Chat Widget](https://sendpulse.com/features/live-chat): SendPulse live chat widget for website customer support
